title: T Cell Clonal Analysis Using Single-cell RNA Sequencing and Reference Maps
author: Massimo Andreatta
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Create Seurat object from counts
steps.instruction: Load the raw count matrix into R and create a Seurat object; optionally subset to 100 cells for testing and project 50 cells for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: raw_counts <- readRDS("path/to/counts.rds")  # load raw counts matrix
seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = raw_counts)  # create Seurat object
seurat_subset <- subset(seurat, cells = 1:100)  # example: keep 100 cells
seurat_projected <- RunUMAP(seurat_subset, dims = 1:30)  # example projection of 50 cells

steps.title: Project data and compute cell‑cycle scores
steps.instruction: Run ProjecTILs to embed the Seurat object in the reference map; ProjecTILs automatically calculates UCell‑based cell‑cycle signature scores.

steps.title: Calculate proliferation fraction for expanded clones
steps.instruction: Identify expanded clonotypes (≥2 cells) and compute, for each, the proportion of cells classified as proliferating.

steps.title: Assess clonal overlap between subtypes
steps.instruction: Compute the Horn‑Morisita index to quantify TCR sharing between T‑cell subtypes.

steps.title: Visualize clonal overlap with circos plot
steps.instruction: Create a circos (chord) diagram of clonal sharing using scRepertoire and circlize.

steps.title: Compute clonotype bias toward cell states
steps.instruction: Calculate a bias metric that measures whether a clonotype is preferentially associated with a particular functional cluster.

substeps.instruction: bias <- clonotypeBias(merged.projected, cloneCall = "cdr3s_pat", split.by = "patient", group.by = "functional.cluster", min.expand = 10)

steps.title: Export bias table and plot top biased clones
steps.instruction: Export the bias results, rank clones by Z‑score, and plot the six most biased clones on the reference embedding.

substeps.instruction: biased <- clonotypeBias(merged.projected, cloneCall = "cdr3s_pat", split.by = "patient", group.by = "functional.cluster", min.expand = 5, exportTable = TRUE)
title <- sprintf("Clone %s - size %d - patient %s", ctype, most.biased[i, "CloneSize"], most.biased[i, "patient"])
